metadata.content: Singapore GP 2026 Sprint weekend dates, schedule, weather, UK start time and how to watch or stream F1 race at Marina Bay Circuit live on Sky Sports | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Singapore GP 2026 Sprint weekend dates, schedule, weather, UK start time and how to watch or stream F1 race at Marina Bay Circuit live on Sky Sports Find out the race-week schedule, weather and how to watch the Sprint weekend at the Singapore Grand Prix; watch every session starting this Friday with Practice at 9.30am and Sprint Qualifying at 1.30pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event Monday 5 October 2026 06:25, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Look back at some of the most dramatic moments to have taken place at the Singapore Grand Prix Formula 1 concludes its Asian triple-header with a Sprint weekend at the Singapore Grand Prix. A dramatic race in Malaysia last time out saw Max Verstappen secure Red Bull's first victory of the season, while Kimi Antonelli extended his lead in the Drivers' Championship to 84 points over George Russell, who was forced to retire late on with a power unit issue. Lewis Hamilton produced an impressive recovery drive, charging from 18th to the podium after a strategy gamble failed to pay off in the mixed conditions. The Ferrari driver will be confident of another strong result at the next round in Singapore, where the tight, twisty streets are likely to suit his strengths. messages.text: Humphries savours 'special' win after ending run of major near-misses

metadata.summary: Luke Humphries was relieved to end his run of near-misses in TV major finals after delivering a sensational comeback victory over Gerwyn Price at the World Grand Prix.
metadata.content: World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries relieved to end losing streak in major finals after comeback win over Gerwyn Price | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries relieved to end losing streak in major finals after comeback win over Gerwyn Price Luke Humphries produced one of the greatest fightbacks in World Grand Prix history to defeat Gerwyn Price 6-4 in the final; Humphries won the double-start event for a second time and extended Price's wait too claim another ranked TV title Ali Stafford Senior Sports Journalist Monday 5 October 2026 06:20, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from a thrilling World Grand Prix final between Gerwyn Price and Luke Humphries Luke Humphries was relieved to end his run of near-misses in TV major finals after delivering a sensational comeback victory over Gerwyn Price at the World Grand Prix. Humphries reached a record-breaking fourth consecutive final at the double-start tournament, where he battled back from 3-0 down to win six of the next seven sets in an impressive 6-4 win over the Welshman. Victory at Leicester's Mattioli Arena followed his win over Price in the 2023 final and makes him just the fourth player ever to claim multiple World Grand Prix titles, with Humphries' latest success securing him the £150,000 first prize. messages.text: Djokovic creates more history with epic Zverev win at China Open

metadata.summary: Novak Djokovic rolled back the years to defeat French Open and US Open champion Alexander Zverev 4-6 6-4 6-4 to reach the semi-finals of the China Open on Sunday.
metadata.content: China Open: Novak Djokovic keeps unblemished record in Beijing by handing Alexander Zverev a rare defeat | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content China Open: Novak Djokovic keeps unblemished record in Beijing by handing Alexander Zverev a rare defeat Novak Djokovic preserves his unblemished record in Beijing by downing in-form Alexander Zverev to set up a semi-final showdown with Daniil Medvedev; you can watch the WTA/ATP China Open and ATP 1000 Shanghai Masters live on Sky Sports Sunday 4 October 2026 15:35, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Novak Djokovic and Alexander Zverev served up an unbelievable rally during their clash at the China Open Novak Djokovic rolled back the years to defeat French Open and US Open champion Alexander Zverev 4-6 6-4 6-4 to reach the semi-finals of the China Open on Sunday. The 39-year-old Serbian created a new piece of tennis history with the best start in men's singles at a tour-level event in the Open Era as he moved to 32-0 in Beijing. With his victory, Djokovic moved past Rafael Nadal for the best start at a single event, with Nadal having won his first 31 matches at the French Open. messages.text: Humphries completes comeback victory over Price in World Grand Prix epic

metadata.summary: Luke Humphries secured a second World Grand Prix title after producing an extraordinary comeback to defeat Gerwyn Price 6-4 in a thrilling final.
metadata.content: World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries beats Gerwyn Price 6-4 after epic comeback to claim major title in Leicester | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries beats Gerwyn Price 6-4 after epic comeback to claim major title in Leicester Luke Humphries recovered from three sets down to beat Gerwyn Price and win the World Grand Prix title for the second time in four years; Humphries avoid a third consecutive runner-up finish at the double-in event, as Price extends his wait for another TV major Ali Stafford Senior Sports Journalist Sunday 4 October 2026 23:06, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the World Grand Prix final between Gerwyn Price and Luke Humphries at the Mattioli Arena Luke Humphries secured a second World Grand Prix title after producing an extraordinary comeback to defeat Gerwyn Price 6-4 in a thrilling final. Humphries, the first player in history to reach the final four years running, rallied from 3-0 down to reel off six of the next seven sets at the Mattioli Arena in Leicester and claim a first major title of the year. The former world champion posted a 93.16 average and fired 10 maximums in a topsy-turvy contest, where Price had early control before Humphries landed a 105 finish in a deciding leg of the fourth set to avoid falling further behind.
